Want to know the crazy thing with old racing cars? You steer with the wheel, throttle, and brake. All 3. It makes sense once you get it, but until then it's maddening.

If you enter the corner hot and brake late, the vehicle becomes unstable.

If you enter slowly and accelerate hard, the vehicle becomes unstable.

If you enter at the correct speed, you likely experience significant understeer.

Therefore, your only choice is one of the first two methods, using the throttle and/or brake to manage the turn. Often, you end up utilizing all three inputs.

I was flying the commercial jetliner from somewhere in the eastern time zone, south to north. Just cruising along in the upper 300 flight levels, when all of a sudden both engines go out. Don't panic, did I just pull a Gimli and mess up my fuel conversions? Nope, I have good fuel. Did I bork up my checklist and forget something? Nope, engines are configured as they should be. I literally have no idea why both engines both shut down at exactly the same time. I configure it to glide, get the APU turned on (it starts, good sign). Still don't panic, work towards air starting the engines. Still don't panic, engine one starts and goes, engine two starts and goes. Don't panic, just flew over the Tennessee-Georgia border, and I know up ahead is a local airport, so I can put it down very safely there. Still not panicking, pull up the charts for approach and accept a vectored arrival for emergency.

Praying the whole time, I nail the approach on the dots. Engines didn't shut down again. I sat there for an hour going over my procedures, trying to figure out what went wrong. I could never figure it out, except a bug in the airplane.

Needless to say, always keep a level head. From up in the 300's down to the ground, I always had a couple plans in case the engines went out. The APU was still running just in case it was needed, but even as far down as the final 500 feet I was visually scanning for fields for a non-field landing.

edit - Actually, another person reminded me of another bad one I had. Final to a major airport one day, the weather in the area had been bad, but had improved by the time I landed. Unfortunately, I was using default weather and apparently one of the stations didn't get the memo. I was about 1000 feet up when the 15 knot headwind turned into a 20 knot tailwind, and I plummet 900 feet towards the houses under the approach path.

Only 900 feet, because I was somehow able to halt the stall just above treetop level. Needless to say I just walled the throttles and went around. My hands didn't stop shaking for another hour or so, and I had trouble sleeping that night due to the adrenaline.
Hence my flair, the first thing I decided to screw around with on the aircraft.

I met Anne three months ago. We were the results of a conspiracy of matchmakers who realized we both shared the same alma mater, THE (snicker) University of Michigan. She's 31, and an actress. Her most famous role had been about 5 years prior when she played one of about a dozen patients to die in a disaster on a medical drama. Most of her roles had been independent films, or glorified extras in poorly performing studio films. What made me fall in love almost instantly was her honesty. She actually saw me play my senior year. She even confessed to heckling me while drunk. I remember the game against our in-state rival; no goals, two terrible turnovers, and getting my ass kicked in a fight as the final horn sounded on a 6-0 drubbing at the hands of our in-state rival. She was willing to give me shit about that game, and damn if I didn't love her for that.

We had been dating for three months, when she invited me to go with her to her movie premier. It was an independent drama about a woman trying to escape a cult, and Anne was one of the fellow cult members of the main female star. When anyone thinks of what a movie premier is about, they think of the famous theater in Hollywood. For comparison, this one was held in a smaller city in California. The best thing you could do on MP to start is to find a server that has a decent mission and low population. Fly around, get some situational awareness, hell even go up with just heaters and ECM pods. Draw the SAM sites out of hiding. Learn to avoid and defend against launches, because if you’re going to hunt SAMs, you’re going to get shot at. Once you’re comfortable getting shot at, load up the SEAD pod and a couple 25’s, and learn to do the close-in killing. ZSU-23’s are best left to cluster bombs or vikhrs, or even a two person team to draw it out if hiding. Once you get the shorter range antiradiation missiles, the 58’s are piece of cake. Start small, get bigger. Do it in steps, and only move on once you’re comfortable. I’m at the point now that I know what’s firing on me by instinct (they’re doing what I’d do if I were them!), and I don’t usually get too concerned unless I’m at max weight.

When I was 12 or 13, my parents drove me to the nearest video store to rent a game for the SNES. What followed is one of my greatest misses, in a way.

Now, there were three people who worked at this video store; the owner, who was probably in his 20's-30's and was a gamer even back in the early-mid 90's when this happened. The second was a fat guy with a goatee, like the Chicken Man in Toy Story 2. The third, however, was a younger woman, probably in the 18-26 age range.

She was at the desk that day, and her and I were the only people in the store. Nothing was amiss, no weirdness going on in the store. I went back to the game section, and started searching for whatever game I wanted to rent that night. After about 15 minutes, I picked the game, got my money out and went to the front desk where holy shit the lady's not wearing a shirt. She had stripped down to her bra.

Okay, I'll power through this. I'm not sure what she's doing, because it was the middle of the summer, and it was probably 90 out that day. She's probably just hot, yeah, that's it.

Then she asks the question that I still wonder what the fuck she was trying to do.

"Have you ever seen a grown woman like me?"

Uhhh

I paid and left. Looking back on the situation, the whole thing was fucking weird.

Right around that time, coincidentally, I started paying more attention to the girls at my school.

Also, I never saw the lady again. I tried to slyly bring it up with the owner later on, and he gave me the look of a guy who knew why I was asking. He changed the subject to the games I was renting.

When I mentioned the next school year that I almost scored with someone possibly twice my age, nobody believed me.
